definition: Gross domestic product measured in current US dollars
limitations: Nominal GDP is affected by inflation and exchange-rate movements

indicator_name: GDP per capita current US dollars
definition: GDP divided by the population, expressed in current US dollars
analytical_purpose: Assess broad economic output per person
limitations: Not a direct measure of household disposable income or purchasing power

definition: Annual percentage growth in GDP measured in constant prices
limitations: Historical growth may be affected by exceptional events and statistical revisions
Population size alone does not establish the addressable consumer market
Population growth does not establish demand for Aurevia products

definition: Annual percentage change in consumer prices measured by the consumer price index
analytical_purpose: Assess inflationary conditions and macroeconomic risk
limitations: National CPI baskets and inflation experiences differ across countries

indicator_name: GDP per capita PPP current international dollars
definition: GDP per capita converted using purchasing power parity rates and expressed in current international dollars
analytical_purpose: Compare broad purchasing-power-adjusted economic output per person across countries
limitations: Not a direct measure of household disposable income; PPP estimates depend on benchmark and estimation methodology
